live_quality_sample.critic_unavailable_reason: test .patchfrog.yml omitted critic_model, defaulted to claude-opus-5, every critic call 404'd and gracefully degraded
live_quality_sample.historical_note: This result is preserved as-is, not rewritten. The config gap it exposed is fixed as of config_semantics_fix below (same PR), but this specific sample genuinely ran before that fix existed and remains reviewer-only data.

config_semantics_fix.root_cause: ReviewConfig.critic_model defaulted to the class-level Anthropic default (claude-opus-5) regardless of provider, so an omitted critic_model produced an impossible provider/model pair for the critic call
config_semantics_fix.mechanism: pydantic model_fields_set distinguishes omitted vs explicitly-set fields; omitted critic_model defaults to the same value as model; omitted request_timeout_seconds defaults to 120.0 for provider=gemini (30.0 unchanged elsewhere)
